title: The Underground – Orlando’s Ultimate Tactical Group Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Looking for a unique indoor adventure in Orlando where you can play, compete, and unwind all in one place? Step into The Underground at Decision Tactical, the city’s only indoor tactical theme park. This live-action maze combines high-energy tactical gameplay with a social, lounge-style atmosphere that feels like stepping inside a real-life video game. No live ammunition, no VR—just pure interactive fun that’s safe for families, friends, and groups.

This indoor experience combines the excitement of escape games, the energy of laser tag, and the challenge of an obstacle course—all in one tactical theme park.
